DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 14 flux

Scores calculables: 10/14 (flux sans score: 4)
Score moyen des flux calculables: 0.388 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.503, Score minimum: 0.293

TOP 3 FLUX SELON L'ANCIEN SCORE PROXY (NON DECISIONNEL CSD):
  1. Magnetization (score: 0.503)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.50 vs bruit blanc 0.26
     - Hurst max: 0.813, Pente FFT: -0.158
  2. Abs_magnetization (score: 0.494)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.64 vs bruit blanc 0.26
     - Hurst max: 0.791, Pente FFT: -0.072
  3. Noise_flux (score: 0.425)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.22 vs bruit blanc 0.26
     - Hurst max: 0.785, Pente FFT: -0.011

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. M_fourth (score: 0.341)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.593
  2. Noise_axis (score: 0.303)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.628
  3. Abs_magnetization_shuffled (score: 0.293)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.547
